purpose: Preserve the chronological state of the property fixture revalidation control center without silently overwriting prior coordination states.
history_rules: Every material control-center state receives a new immutable entry.
Each entry identifies the validation or impact event that established the state.
Technical coordination history remains separate from legal-source and publication history.
guardrails: This history is technical coordination history only.
It does not establish real property facts or legal correctness.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
Later states must be recorded as new entries.
